description.narrative: The proposed program will help the Government of Tonga implement reforms to mitigate fragilities intensified by the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, and the 2022 volcanic eruption at Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha‘apai (HTHH) and associated tsunami waves. The program will also build resilience against disasters, which will be intensified by climate change. The program comprises two subprograms that will (i) strengthen public sector management and sustainability, and (ii) boost social and economic resilience in Tonga.

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jan 01, 2022 - Dec 31, 2023

description.narrative:
Action 1: To improve public sector management, the cabinet approved for submission to the Legislative Assembly for enactment the new Public Financial Management Bill 2023 which will: (i) improve fiscal management through the codification of fiscal responsibility principles and a requirement to prepare a medium-term fiscal strategy; (ii) strengthen internal and expenditure controls through the establishment of an internal audit function that reports to an internal audit committee; (iii) strengthen the management of government liabilities by requiring a debt management strategy, stipulating a numerical limit on the stock of government guaranteed debt, and setting out the criteria for the granting of future guarantees; and (iv) support fiscal and debt transparency by providing guidance and deadlines for the online publication of budget documents. Target date: 2023-12-31
Action 2: To support the implementation of electronic tax collections and improved tax administration, the Minister responsible for Revenue and Customs approved with immediate effect the Revenue Services Administration (Electronic Sales Register System) Regulations 2022. Target date: 2023-12-31
Action 1: To improve public debt management and to achieve a sustainable fiscal policy the cabinet will approve with immediate effect regulations to the revised Public Financial Management Act which will include improved debt management and provide additional guidance on public financial management. Target date: 2025-06-30

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 2 Implementation Period: Jan 01, 2024 - Jun 30, 2025

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Public sector management and sustainability improved NA
Action 2: To support domestic revenue mobilization and remove distortions for the tax system, the cabinet will approve with immediate effect tax reforms that, among other provisions, reduce perpetual tax exemptions. Target date: 2025-06-30
Action 1: 1.3. To strengthen the social protection system and support a timely and efficient disaster response, the cabinet approved with immediate effect a gender-inclusive National Social Protection Policy 2023-2033 which: (i) is informed by an assessment of gender and social vulnerabilities in Tonga; (ii) targets increased access to economic opportunities such as employment and skills development programs for vulnerable groups including women-headed households, youth, and people with disabilities. (iii) establishes an implementation taskforce that includes the Women Affairs and Gender Equity Division as one of the key members. Target date: 2023-12-31
